info.instructions:
Listen to the audio or read the transcript below. Identify the emotions the speaker themselves is conveying. Focus on how the speaker feels, not on the topic they are describing.
  • Provide up to 5 emotions and rate the intensity of each on a scale from 0 (not intense) to 5 (very intense).
  • If you use fewer than 5 fields, set the slider to 0 for any unused fields.
Example: the utterance 'I, uh, I don't know, I just, I really wish they would, you know, just listen to me.' could reflect the speaker's emotion frustration with moderate intensity (3) or helplessness with low intensity (2).
